site.audience: UI/UX designers, product designers, and design teams seeking inspiration and reference material

brief.title: ScreenVault — UI & UX design inspiration for mobile & web apps
brief.one_liner: Save hours of UI & UX research with a library of 400,000+ fully searchable mobile & web app screenshots.
brief.goal: Convert visitors into free or paid users by showcasing the breadth and utility of the design inspiration library, highlighting key features like search, flows, Figma integration, and social proof from industry professionals.

pages.objective: Introduce the product, demonstrate its value through features and social proof, and drive sign-ups.

navigation.trigger: Join for free button in hero
See our plans link in hero

interactions.expected: Animated counting numbers for apps, screens, and flows statistics

interactions.trigger: Click on tab labels (Screens, UI Elements, Flows, Text in Screenshot) in the search feature section
interactions.expected: Content area switches to show corresponding search results view

interactions.trigger: Click on filter pills like Profile, Wallet, Welcome, Account Setup, etc.
interactions.expected: Screenshot grid updates to show filtered results matching the selected category

interactions.trigger: Click on Videos or Prototype mode toggle in flows section
interactions.expected: Content switches between video flow view and interactive prototype step-by-step view

interactions.trigger: Testimonials section auto-scrolls or user scrolls horizontally
interactions.expected: Testimonial cards scroll in a continuous marquee/carousel pattern across multiple rows

interactions.trigger: CTA section visible with app icon rows
interactions.expected: App icons scroll in a continuous horizontal marquee animation in alternating directions

data_display.description: Key statistics showing the size of the design inspiration library including number of apps, screens, and flows.
Filter pill categories available in the search feature section for browsing design patterns.
Tab navigation options in the search feature section for different types of design assets.
Three key tool features for going from inspiration to creation, displayed as feature cards.
User testimonials from design professionals at various companies praising the platform.
